# 3) Formatter Y en h:mm
def hours_to_hmm(x, pos):
    # x = heures (float) -> "H:MM"
    if np.isnan(x):
        return ""
    total_minutes = int(round(x * 60))
    h = total_minutes // 60
    m = total_minutes % 60
    return f"{h}:{m:02d}"

fmt = FuncFormatter(hours_to_hmm)

# 4) Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.barplot(data=df_avg, x='Stage', y='Duration_h', palette='pastel', edgecolor='black',hue='Stage', dodge=False)

# Axe Y formaté en h:mm
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(fmt)

# Valeurs sur chaque barre (en h:mm)
for p in ax.patches:
    height = p.get_height()
    ax.annotate(hours_to_hmm(height, None),
                (p.get_x() + p.get_width()/2, height),
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, xytext=(0, 5), textcoords='offset points')

plt.xlabel('Sleep Stage')

df_sleep_event['duration'] = pd.to_timedelta(df_sleep_event['duration'], errors='coerce')
df_sleep_event['event_lower'] = df_sleep_event['event'].str.lower()

def fmt_duration(td):
    mins = int(td.total_seconds() // 60)
    h, m = divmod(mins, 60)
    return f"{h}:{m:02d}"

palette = {
    'awake':        ('#e74c3c', 0.22),  
    'light_sleep':  ("#74eeee", 0.18),  
    'deep_sleep':   ("#0099ff", 0.18),  
    'rem_sleep':    ('#8e44ad', 0.18),  
    'nrem_sleep':   ("#00ff55", 0.18),  
}
nights_all = (
    df_sleep_event['timestamp'].dt.normalize()
    .dropna()
    .sort_values()
    .unique()
)
if len(nights_all) == 0:
    raise ValueError("Aucune nuit détectée dans df_sleep_event.")

nights_pick = nights_all[-10:] 

nrows = len(nights_pick)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    nrows=nrows, ncols=1, figsize=(20, max(6, 3.7*nrows)),
    sharey=True
)

if nrows == 1:
    axes = [axes]

legend_states_seen = {}

for ax, night_date in zip(axes, nights_pick):
    wide_start = night_date + pd.Timedelta(hours=18)         # 18:00
    wide_end   = night_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1, hours=12) # J+1 12:00

    events_win = df_sleep_event.loc[
        (df_sleep_event['timestamp'] >= wide_start) &
        (df_sleep_event['timestamp'] <= wide_end)
    ].sort_values('timestamp')
    """
    sleep_mask = events_win['event_lower'] != 'awake'
    if sleep_mask.any():
        night_start = events_win.loc[sleep_mask, 'timestamp'].min()
    else:
        night_start = wide_start

    awake_mask = events_win['event_lower'] == 'awake'
    if awake_mask.any():
        night_end = (events_win.loc[awake_mask, 'timestamp'] + events_win.loc[awake_mask, 'duration']).max()
    else:
        night_end = (events_win['timestamp'] + events_win['duration']).max() if not events_win.empty else wide_end"""


    night_start = night_date + pd.Timedelta(hours=22)         # 22:00
    night_end   = night_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1, hours=9)  # J+1 09:00
    # Garde-fous
    if pd.isna(night_start) or pd.isna(night_end) or night_end <= night_start:
        night_start, night_end = wide_start, wide_end

    # Stress filtré sur la nuit
    df_stress_night = df_stress.loc[
        (df_stress['timestamp'] >= night_start) &
        (df_stress['timestamp'] <= night_end)
    ].sort_values('timestamp')

    # Lissage (rolling 15min) — si timestamps irréguliers, on peut uniformiser :
    # df_stress_night = (df_stress_night.set_index('timestamp')

    # df_stress_night['stress_smooth'] = df_stress_night['stress'].rolling('15min').mean()
    df_stress_night = df_stress_night.set_index('timestamp')
    df_stress_night['stress_smooth'] = df_stress_night['stress'].rolling('5min').mean()

    for state, (color, alpha) in palette.items():
        rows = events_win.loc[events_win['event_lower'] == state]
        for _, row in rows.iterrows():
            ev_start = row['timestamp']
            ev_end   = row['timestamp'] + row['duration']
            span_start = max(ev_start, night_start)
            span_end   = min(ev_end, night_end)
            if pd.notnull(span_start) and pd.notnull(span_end) and span_start < span_end:
                ax.axvspan(span_start, span_end, color=color, alpha=alpha)
                legend_states_seen[state] = (color, alpha)

    if not df_stress_night.empty:
        ax.plot(df_stress_night.index, df_stress_night['stress'], alpha=0.25)
        ax.plot(df_stress_night.index, df_stress_night['stress_smooth'], color='black', linewidth=1.6)

    awake_rows = events_win.loc[events_win['event_lower'] == 'awake']
    for _, row in awake_rows.iterrows():
        ev_start = row['timestamp']
        ev_end   = row['timestamp'] + row['duration']
        span_start = max(ev_start, night_start)
        span_end   = min(ev_end, night_end)
        if pd.notnull(span_start) and pd.notnull(span_end) and span_start < span_end:
            dur = span_end - span_start
            x_mid = span_start + (dur / 2)
            y_top = ax.get_ylim()[-1]

                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',

    ax.set_xlim(night_start, night_end)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
    ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.25)

    ax.set_ylabel('')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Paramètres
start_hour = 22
end_hour = 9
resample_freq = '5min'   # pas d'échantillonnage pour superposer proprement
smooth_win   = '15min'   # fenêtre de lissage

# On prend les dates présentes dans df_stress (tu peux aussi partir de df_sleep_event)
nights_all = (
    pd.to_datetime(df_stress['timestamp']).dt.normalize()
    .dropna()
    .unique()
)
nights_all = sorted(nights_all)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

for night_date in nights_all:
    night_start = night_date + pd.Timedelta(hours=start_hour)          # 22:00
    night_end   = night_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1, hours=end_hour)    # J+1 09:00
    
    mask = (df_stress['timestamp'] >= night_start) & (df_stress['timestamp'] <= night_end)
    df_night = df_stress.loc[mask].sort_values('timestamp').copy()
    if df_night.empty:
        continue

    # Assurer les types
    df_night['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df_night['timestamp'], errors='coerce')

    # Index relatif = Timedelta depuis 22:00  → nécessaire pour resample()
    df_night['t_rel'] = df_night['timestamp'] - night_start          # Timedelta
    df_night = df_night.set_index('t_rel').sort_index()

    # Rééchantillonnage régulier + interpolation
    df_night = df_night.resample(resample_freq).mean().interpolate()

    # Lissage temporel (rolling par durée)
    df_night['stress_smooth'] = df_night['stress'].rolling(smooth_win, min_periods=1).mean()

    # Pour tracer, convertit l’axe X en minutes (numérique)
    x_min = df_night.index / np.timedelta64(1, 'm')
    plt.plot(x_min, df_night['stress_smooth'])

# Axe X : 22h → 09h (0 → 660 minutes)
ticks_min = np.arange(0, 11*60 + 1, 60)  # 0,60,...,660
labels = ["22h","23h","00h","01h","02h","03h","04h","05h","06h","07h","08h","09h"]
plt.xticks(ticks_min, labels)

plt.title("Stress lissé par nuit — superposé (22:00 → 09:00)")
plt.xlabel("Heure de la nuit")
plt.ylabel("Stress")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ── Hypothèses d'entrée ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# df_stress: DataFrame avec colonnes ['timestamp', 'stress']
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Sécuriser les types
df_stress = df_stress.copy()
df_stress['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df_stress['timestamp'], errors='coerce')
df_stress = df_stress.dropna(subset=['timestamp', 'stress'])

# Paramètres de la nuit et du lissage
START_HOUR = 22
END_HOUR = 9      # le lendemain
ROLL_WIN = '5min' # moyenne mobile 5 minutes
BASE_FREQ = '1min'
OUT_FREQ  = '5min'

# Index canonique commun pour toutes les nuits : 0 → 660 min, pas 5 min
idx_5min = pd.timedelta_range(start='0min', end='660min', freq=OUT_FREQ)

# Lister toutes les nuits (par date normalisée)
nights_all = sorted(df_stress['timestamp'].dt.normalize().unique())

curves = []
for night_date in nights_all:
    night_start = night_date + pd.Timedelta(hours=START_HOUR)
    night_end   = night_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1, hours=END_HOUR)

    # Filtre de la fenêtre de nuit
    mask = (df_stress['timestamp'] >= night_start) & (df_stress['timestamp'] <= night_end)
    df_night = df_stress.loc[mask, ['timestamp', 'stress']].sort_values('timestamp')
    if df_night.empty:
        continue

    # Axe temps relatif (TimedeltaIndex) depuis 22:00
    df_night = df_night.assign(t_rel=lambda d: d['timestamp'] - night_start).set_index('t_rel')

    # 1) Rééchantillonnage fin (1 min) pour régulariser
    # 2) Lissage moyenne mobile 5 min (rolling sur durée)
    # 3) Sortie à pas 5 min
    s = (df_night['stress']
         .resample(BASE_FREQ).mean().interpolate()
         .rolling(ROLL_WIN, min_periods=1).mean()
         .resample(OUT_FREQ).mean())

    # Recalage sur l'index canonique 0..660 min pour pouvoir moyenner entre nuits
    s = s.reindex(idx_5min).interpolate(limit_direction='both')
    curves.append(s)

if not curves:
    raise ValueError("Aucune donnée de stress trouvée sur les nuits 22h→09h.")

# Moyenne (et couverture facultative)
M = pd.concat(curves, axis=1)
avg_curve = M.mean(axis=1)          # stress moyen par instant (toutes les nuits)
n_count   = M.notna().sum(axis=1)   # nb de nuits contribuant à chaque point (optionnel)

# Tracé
x_min = idx_5min / np.timedelta64(1, 'm')  # minutes depuis 22:00

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.plot(x_min, avg_curve, linewidth=2, label='Stress moyen (MA 5 min)')

# Axes/ticks 22→09 (0..660 min)
ticks_min = np.arange(0, 11*60 + 1, 60)  # 0,60,...,660
labels = ['22h','23h','00h','01h','02h','03h','04h','05h','06h','07h','08h','09h']
plt.xticks(ticks_min, labels)

plt.title('Stress moyen par nuit (22:00 → 09:00) — moyenne mobile 5 min')
plt.xlabel('Heure de la nuit')
plt.ylabel('Stress moyen')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import MultipleLocator, FuncFormatter
import seaborn as sns

# Corriger stress négatifs
df_joined.loc[df_joined['stress'] < 0, 'stress'] = 0

# Heure de la journée en heures décimales
df_joined = df_joined.copy()
df_joined['tod_hours'] = (
    df_joined['timestamp'].dt.hour
    + df_joined['timestamp'].dt.minute / 60
    + df_joined['timestamp'].dt.second / 3600
)

# Nouvelle colonne : True si stress > 50
df_joined['stress_high'] = df_joined['stress'] > 80

# Fonction format HH:MM
def hhmm(x, pos):
    total_minutes = int(round(x * 60))
    h = (total_minutes // 60) % 24
    m = total_minutes % 60
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Palette : rouge si stress_high = True, bleu sinon
palette = {True: "red", False: "blue"}

df_joined["stresss_10"] = df_joined["stress"]/10
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_joined,
    x="tod_hours", y="heart_rate",
    hue="stress_high",   # utilise la colonne booléenne
    palette=palette,
    alpha=0.6,
    ax=ax
)

ax.set_title("Heart Rate vs Stress (toutes journées empilées)")
ax.set_xlabel("Heure")
ax.set_ylabel("Heart Rate (bpm)")

ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MultipleLocator(1))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(hhmm))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(MultipleLocator(0.25))

ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
ax.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
